text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While walking around campus during my
lunch
break...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! ♪ Yuki, your chocolates were so
yummy. ♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Yer choc'lates were real delicious
too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
And the wrapp'n was like a disco ball!
Where'dja
get all them choc'lates,
anyhow?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Heh! Since I'm a mature, grown-up
woman, I have
no problem finding all the
trendy stores! ☆

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Holy cannoli! You're a real city girl!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Mmhm! Feel free to ask me for advice
when it
comes to shopping!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oh! Trainer! Over here! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Heehee, got tired of waiting for my
chocolate,
huh? Can't say I blame
you. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'll talk to you later, Yuki! I've got to do

something suuuuuper grown-up. ☆

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
S-s... someth'n grown-up?! Wh-wh-what's
that
s'pposed to mean?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't mean anything, but Mayano
Top Gun
drags me away before I can
explain that to
Yukino Bijin...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Here you go! Some chocolates from me
to you.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Heh! Go on, open it! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Feeling the weight of her gaze, I begin
to open
the package to find...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An almost unbelievable number of
chocolates
packed inside.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I bought the star-shaped ones at a
department
store, and the hearts are
from the store inside the
station!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! I went to a ton of stores all by
myself to
get ready for today!
choice_data_list: いっぱい買ったんだな
いっぱい買ったんだね

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Soooo...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Now you have no choice but to take me
on a date
as thanks for all these
chocolates!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I agree to her terms, and we go to a
chocolate
store for our date.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A chocolate cupcake with a somewhat
simple,
homemade feel.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The chocolate is overflowing from the
wrapper in
some places, but it still looks
like it was made
with care.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yay!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Say that again once you've
eaten it! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Heh! It's a one-of-a-kind Maya
Cake—you won't
find it anywhere else!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...It's really special, got it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I eat the rest of the slightly-too-sweet
chocolate
cupcake bit by bit throughout
the day.
